title: DGR Job Fair – Bangalore (Army, Navy, Air Force ESM)
description: Multi-sector job fair organized by DGR for retired JCOs/OR and officers. Companies from security, logistics, hospitality, and IT sectors participating. Walk-in with service documents.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen (All ranks), ESM widows

title: Security Guard – CISF Empanelled Companies (Pan India)
description: Requirement of ex-servicemen as security guards / supervisors / managers in PSUs and private companies empanelled with DGR Security Agency Scheme. Apply through respective RSB/ZSB.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen (JCOs/OR), Age: below 55 years

title: KSB Job Fair – New Delhi (Officers & JCOs)
description: Kendriya Sainik Board annual job fair at Sena Bhavan premises. Openings in banking, insurance, railways, and defence-linked PSUs. Bring original discharge book and service documents.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen Officers and JCOs/OR with minimum 10th pass

title: BSF Head Constable (GD) – Ex-Servicemen Quota
description: Border Security Force invites applications from ex-servicemen for Head Constable (General Duty) posts under the ex-servicemen re-employment scheme. Online application only.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen (ORs) who have served minimum 10 years. Age relaxation: 3 years over normal upper limit.

title: CISF Sub-Inspector (GD) – Ex-Servicemen Re-employment
description: Central Industrial Security Force recruitment for SI (GD) post under ESM re-employment quota. Candidates must produce valid ESM certificate from respective Zila Sainik Board.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen JCOs/equivalent, Age: up to 50 years

title: Logistics & Transport Management – DGR Empanelled Firms
description: DGR is placing ex-servicemen in logistics management roles across empanelled freight forwarding and transport companies. Openings for drivers, supervisors and operations managers.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen (all ranks), Drivers: valid HMV licence required

title: NCS – Defence PSU Openings for Ex-Servicemen (Q1 2026)
description: National Career Service portal quarterly listing of Defence PSU vacancies with ex-servicemen reservation: BEL, BEML, HAL, Ordnance Factory Board. Apply through NCS portal.
eligibility: ESM with relevant technical qualifications. Reservation as per DoP&T norms.

title: HAL – Apprentice Technician (ESM Ward Quota)
description: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited apprentice scheme with 10% seats reserved for wards of ex-servicemen. Trainee positions in aircraft maintenance, avionics and manufacturing.
eligibility: Wards of ESM, ITI qualified, Age: 18-25 years

title: Indian Railways – Group C Posts (ESM Quota 14.5%)
description: RRB notification for Group C posts (Technician, JE, Station Master) with 14.5% reservation for ex-servicemen as per Railway Services (Relaxation of Upper Age Limit) Rules.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen as per RRB norms. Age relaxation: actual service + 3 years.

title: KSB Resettlement Camp – Lucknow (UP)
description: Kendriya Sainik Board resettlement camp with on-the-spot career counselling, document verification for welfare schemes, and direct company interviews for ESM from UP/Uttarakhand.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen and widows from UP and Uttarakhand

title: DGR Job Fair – Chennai (Jul 2026)
description: Upcoming DGR mega job fair at Chennai for Tamil Nadu and Puducherry ESM. Sectors: IT/ITES, hospitality, manufacturing, private security. Bring ESM card and discharge book.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen (all branches), ESM widows, dependants

title: DGR Job Fair – Pune (Aug 2026)
description: DGR Job Fair at Khadki Cantonment for ESM from Maharashtra and Goa. Major recruiters from auto-ancillary, banking, infrastructure and security sectors expected.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen, ESM widows

title: CRPF Constable (Tech & Tradesman) – ESM Re-employment
description: Central Reserve Police Force re-employment of ex-servicemen as Constable (Tech & Tradesman). Trades: Cook, Barber, Safai Karamchari, Bugler, Tailor. Apply via CRPF recruitment portal.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen (ORs only). Age: up to 47 years. Must have trade qualification.

title: ECHS – Medical Assistant Posts (ESM)
description: DESW circular for appointment of ex-servicemen (medical assistants/paramedics) in ECHS polyclinics across India. Preference to those with service in Army Medical Corps.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen with AMC/nursing/paramedic background. Age: up to 50 years.

title: Ordnance Factory Board – Civilian Mazdoor (ESM Quota)
description: OFB recruitment for Civilian Mazdoor posts at various ordnance factories with 10% reservation for ex-servicemen. Factories in Jabalpur, Pune, Kolkata, Kanpur.
eligibility: ESM (ORs), Minimum 10th pass, Age: up to 50 years.

title: BEML – Heavy Vehicle Operator (ESM Category)
description: Bharat Earth Movers Limited (BEML) recruitment for heavy vehicle operators and equipment drivers under ESM quota. Positions at Mysore and Bangalore plants.
eligibility: ESM with HMV licence. Trade: Driver MT or equivalent. Age: below 50.

title: KSB Job Fair – Hyderabad (Telangana & AP ESM)
description: Kendriya Sainik Board organizes employment fair at Secunderabad Cantonment for Telangana and Andhra Pradesh ESM. IT, banking, and security companies participating.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen and ESM widows from Telangana and Andhra Pradesh

title: Hotel & Hospitality – DGR Tourism Scheme
description: DGR Tourism scheme placement of ex-servicemen as hotel security managers, front-desk supervisors, and catering staff in ITDC and state tourism department hotels.
eligibility: ESM (JCOs/OR). Preference: Ex-catering/hospitality trades.

title: NSG – Special Action Group (ESM Re-employment)
description: MHA circular for lateral induction of ex-special forces personnel into National Security Guard. Limited vacancies. Apply through respective regiment records offices.
eligibility: Ex-special forces (Para SF, Marcos, Garud). Service: minimum 15 years. Age: below 42.

title: ITBP Constable (GD) – Ex-Servicemen Quota 2026
description: Indo-Tibetan Border Police recruitment for Constable (GD) with 10% ESM reservation. Physical tests adapted for ex-servicemen age group. Apply online at itbpolice.nic.in.
eligibility: ESM (ORs), Age: up to 47 years, Physical medical standard B-1

title: Coal India – Security Guard (ESM Welfare Scheme)
description: Coal India Limited empanelment of ESM as security guards in collieries across Eastern Coalfields, Bharat Coking Coal and South Eastern Coalfields. Posted in respective state coalfields.
eligibility: ESM (ORs), Age: below 55. Valid ESM ID and discharge certificate required.

title: ONGC – Junior Assistant Technician (ESM Horizontal Reservation)
description: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd. vacancy for Junior Assistant Technician. Horizontal ESM reservation applies across all categories. Apply via ONGC recruitment portal.
eligibility: ESM with relevant trade ITI certificate. Age relaxation as per DoPT norms.

title: DGR Job Fair – Chandigarh (Sep 2026)
description: DGR Job Fair at Chandimandir Cantonment for Punjab, Haryana, HP and J&K ESM. Recruiters from banking, logistics, education and security sectors. Registration starts from 1 Aug 2026.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen and widows from Punjab, Haryana, HP, J&K, Ladakh

title: BHEL – Supervisor Trainee (ESM Category)
description: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd opens Supervisor Trainee positions in electrical and mechanical engineering with ESM horizontal reservation. Training at Haridwar and Bhopal plants.
eligibility: ESM with diploma in electrical/mechanical. Age: below 45.

title: KSB – Free Vocational Training (Skill India ESM)
description: KSB sponsors free skill-development courses for ESM and their spouses under Skill India: Computer basics, driving HMV, electrician, plumbing, beauty & wellness. Apply through ZSB.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen and their dependants. No age bar.

title: State Police Forces – ESM Re-employment (MHA Circular 2026)
description: MHA/DESW circular directing all state governments to implement 10% horizontal ESM reservation in state police constable and sub-inspector posts. Check your state police recruitment board.
eligibility: ESM (all ranks). State-specific age relaxation applies.

title: BEL – Quality Control Inspector (ESM Horizontal Reservation)
description: Bharat Electronics Limited recruits Quality Control Inspectors with ESM reservation. Testing and inspection roles at Pune, Navi Mumbai, Ghaziabad. ITI/diploma in electronics required.
eligibility: ESM with electronics/electrical trade. Age relaxation: 5 years for ESM.

title: Central Govt Group D – NCS ESM Reserved Vacancies (Q3 2026)
description: Quarterly NCS portal update of Central Government Group D posts across ministries with ESM horizontal reservation. Departments: Postal, Railways, Defence, Finance.
eligibility: ESM (ORs), 8th/10th pass minimum, Age relaxation per DoPT circular.

title: AAI – Junior Executive (ESM Reserved Posts)
description: Airports Authority of India recruitment for Junior Executive posts in electronics/electrical/civil streams with ESM horizontal reservation. Online application via AAI careers portal.
eligibility: ESM with BE/B.Tech in relevant stream. Age: up to 30 years (ESM relaxation applicable).

title: DGR Job Fair – Kolkata (East India ESM)
description: DGR Job Fair at Fort William premises for West Bengal, Bihar, Odisha, North-East states ESM. Tea garden, port logistics, banking and private security recruiters attending.
eligibility: Ex-Servicemen and widows from Eastern states
